- Dependencies: SOC2 evidence, procurement timing, legal redlines, engineering evaluation (integration spike)

- Economic buyer
- Security owner (SOC2 / architecture reviewer)
- Legal owner (contract counterparty)
- Engineering lead (integration / spike owner)

Action items for BrightData: please reply with the owner names and any procurement constraints (e.g., PO cadence or internal approval gates).

Attaching: BrightData_MAP_v1.xlsx (see milestone dates and owner columns).

Thanks — I will incorporate any updates and circulate v1.1 by EOD.
